title: Truisms (Tab)
summary: Jenny Holzer's truisms relocated to the one public LED ticker the browser owns: the tab title.
mechanism: A character-clock marquee streams appropriated truisms through document.title, which persists across tab-switches as the web's public signage.
references: Jenny Holzer, Spectacolor LED board, Times Square (1982)
net.art (the scrolling-title trick / browser chrome as material)
